title: A sorok között olvasva (Reading Between the Lines)
grammar: Register Modulation (Ön vs Te) & Essential Spoken Idioms (dűlőre jut, képben van)

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can switch appropriately between formal (Ön) and informal (te) registers.
I can deploy key spoken idioms like dűlőre jut and lépést tart.
I can use four words for stylistic nuance, language register, expression and everyday language.
I can say what képben van means and that I keep pace with developments.
